name: helper-visible-sharing
goal: Every listed helper has at least two distinct component, service or model links in Used In, with eligibility and display using the same resolved consumer set

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Previous Used In UI 5f3e02d7 exposed a mismatch: broad helperContract counts named-function consumers while visible links resolve only component/service/model unit ids. Ten actual cards include zero/one visible users. Align inclusion with that same visible set; no card design change.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing card SSR explicitly accepted a dash for zero visible consumers, and browser fixture only had one positively shared helper. Extend shared fixture with zero/one/missing/same-unit different-symbol cases, change the normal card assertion to exclude all below threshold, and retain two/three-user cases. Test typecheck and lint pass before freezing.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen test commit 0d1249ee fails in all three viewports with only helpers used in two distinct visible places are listed: five cards are present instead of the single qualifying helper. Record 41cfb79dcd3608d503661b06ac0e757c7cb2dff62abbfac087f6f6c3d6e82e2d; before screenshots /tmp/harness-helper-sharing-before.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Filter each helper row with its already resolved distinct Used In links >=2, retaining purity and three-link display cap. Strengthen the project acceptance-review rule so eligibility thresholds and visible summaries share the same set, and keep below-threshold examples in standard unit/browser tests. Verify rejection by restoring old inclusion in an isolated archive.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Entity catalog now filters each pure helper by the same deduplicated eligible Used In set (at least two). Existing three-link cap is above the threshold and preserves that decision. Updated unit responsibility and project Catalog Threshold Review to require shared-set eligibility and boundary cases.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
